text:
CORRECTION to something I said on the board last pass. I stated this bead had "moved onto the critical path" now that the dense-metric path is confirmed runtime-bound. That is wrong.

Checked: R/crossnobis.R, R/geometry-plan.R, R/metric-learning.R and R/residual-statistics.R contain no reference to measurement_form, .measurement_* or measurement-kernel.R. This bead lives in the measurement-form and connectivity subsystem, which the crossnobis scale gate does not exercise at all.

So the priority is unchanged from when I filed it: p2, latent, and it matters when the measurement-form subsystem is asked to scale - not for Epic 8s current gate. The preflight that sizes buffers by allocating them (measurement-kernel.R:236-238) and the two object.size calls inside the per-feature-block loop (:332-339) are still worth fixing, on the original grounds and no more.
